title: The Gangstas invade Public Enemy’s territory
summary: New Jack and Mustafa challenge the crowd’s established brawling favorites. Their rivalry turns tag-team matches into a struggle over which duo represents ECW’s streets and audience.

chapters.title: The Gangstas arrive
chapters.result: The Gangstas debut by attacking Public Enemy.
chapters.context: The newcomers immediately target ECW’s most recognizable tag team.

chapters.title: The Gangstas win at Heat Wave
chapters.result: New Jack and Mustafa defeat Public Enemy.
chapters.context: The challengers prove they can match their opponents in a violent headline rivalry.

chapters.title: Public Enemy wins its farewell chapter
chapters.context: The victory closes their original ECW run before leaving for WCW.
